notes.title: A statement from the development team of REBOANT:ENDLESS DAWN
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

After several months’ dedication, REBOANT:ENDLESS DAWN finally is going online to meet you as an early access version in this month.

Since the demo version of REBOANT was launched on steam on 22th, Nov. last year, we’ve constantly received feedbacks and praise from players around the world, which strengthened our confidence to pursue our dreams that to develop the best VR product under multiple international standards.

However, due to unexpected situations occurred in our partner side who represented our game for distribution, we apologize on all the inconvenience that may have impacted on you. We’ll operate the early access and completed versions by ourselves on steam under our own account. As one compensation, we’re contacting with Steam on how to offer a favorable price to customers who bought this demo version before 21st, March. We sincerely hope you can stay with us. We want to provide the games that you love. We always think highly of all your feedbacks and your thoughts. And we’ll keep endeavoring in creating the best product that can exceed your expectation as utmost degree as possible. We need you. We love you. 

For early access version you can get to it through:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/797040/Reboant__Endless_Dawn/

REBOANT:ENDLESS DAWN is a sci-fi FPS game set in a futuristic world. With its huge worldview, broad level presentation, cinematic graphics, creative interaction, advanced technology and impressive gameplay, we’re aiming to produce an internationally recognizable FPS game from which players will get strong spiritual and visual impacts in the realistic alien planet world. Your support is our biggest encouragement. Thanks for standing by us. Thanks for your support.

From  REBOANT development team

notes.title: Upload Log December 28, 2017
notes.notes:
Upload Log December 28, 2017

December is really a busy month.
We conducted intensive development of Reboant in December.
Mainly solved a few problems

First of all
We've optimized Reboant's performance, and now we have three options for low, medium and high.
In the next update, we will open more settings options.
Already support I5-GTX960-8G PC to start the game.
And this optimization reduces the probability of game error.
Second
We have optimized the client's resources, currently reduced by half.
This will allow us to have more optimization and content space.
Third
We fixed Oculus support.
Fourth
We added a double-hold mode to this gun.
Currently dual-mode will be held in hand can not open the sniper mode.
Sniper mode we are making adjustments, so stay tuned.

At last
We found that there are problems with the IK of the arms and that we will solve it as soon as possible.

PS: As you can see, ReboantOnline, ha ha ha ha ha

Happy New Year

notes.title: Development Log 2017-12-1
notes.notes:
Development Log in busy November

The dev team stayed up late and fixed some issues in the last few days of November.

First of all we have optimized the engine's performance.  The chances of certain errors have been reduced.

Secondly we solved the problem of Oc adaptation and added Oculus compatibility. We are still working on Ms device adaptation.

Thirdly we adjusted and completed sniper mode for the first gun. As uploaded there is a picture of double scope. The picture will show some details of sniper mode. We will update some more developing log details periodically in the future.

Thank you for supporting and subscribing.

notes.title: Reboant "Early Access" sells for .99 cents
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Yes, this is true, The Reboant "Early Access" is just 99 cents.

The resons it is so inexpensive is because this demo very short.  
But don't let that fool you. We want to show everyone what the game is about and what the future holds for everyone.

We beleive it would be unfair to ask the community to purchase a game at full price at this point.  It is important for us to be totally transparent to the community.  Honesty will get you far in life.  :-)

Keep in mind there will be a discount for those who buy the Demo. ;-)

Look for many patches and updates as we work towards full release and please feel free to leave your reviews and post any questions, recomendations, or concerns on our discussion forums or private messages to your team members. 

Once again, THANK YOU for your interest in Reboant.

notes.title: Reboant Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

Today (11/21/2017) the Reboant Early Access has been released. 
Because this is our first Steam Game, we made the mistake of not putting this on the official "Early Access". Our apologies for the confusion. 

To be fair we adjusted the pricing to .99 cents.

Players should be able to get the game now with no problem.  We want as many people as possible to get the Early Access so pass the word. ;-)

Your input is key, so feel free to make any suggestions you want.  Player input is always a good thing for everyone!

After the Early Access is released we will continue to patch and update the game.

We will also continue to share our progress with everyone.

Thanks for your support!
